visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A top-down close-up shot of a steaming plate of stir-fried eggplant, green peppers, and sliced pork belly is presented as the finished dish. A person's hand uses wooden chopsticks to lift a juicy piece of meat, showcasing the texture. The background reveals a clean kitchen with a pink pan. (2) The scene shifts to a pair of hands at a light wooden cutting board. Using a large professional knife, the hands slice several deep purple eggplants into even chunks and then carefully split each chunk in half lengthwise. The kitchen environment is brightly lit and minimalist. (3) The hands place the freshly cut eggplant pieces into a stainless steel bowl filled with clear water and a spoonful of white salt. A small green ceramic plate is placed on top of the eggplants to submerge them completely in the brine. (4) Diagonally slicing green long peppers (shishito type) into several segments, the hands work efficiently on the wooden board. The discarded stems are moved to the side, and a plate of prepared peppers is visible in the background, ready for cooking. (5) Thinly sliced pink marbled pork belly strips are laid out on the cutting board. The hands use the knife to cut the stack of meat into shorter, bite-sized pieces. The focus remains strictly on the food preparation and the physical movements of the hands. (6) In a small white ceramic bowl, a dark savory sauce is combined with minced white garlic and a small dollop of red chili paste. A small wooden spoon is used to stir the ingredients into a thick, uniform mixture. (7) The hands take the soaked eggplant chunks, which have been drained, and place them on the cutting board. A white paper towel is used to meticulously pat each piece dry, ensuring no excess moisture remains before the frying process begins. (8) Raw pork belly slices are transferred from a white plate into a cold, empty pink cast iron pan. A hand uses wooden chopsticks to spread the slices into a flat layer across the bottom of the pan to ensure even rendering. (9) As the heat is applied, the pork belly begins to sizzle and change color from pink to white and then golden brown. The hands use chopsticks to flip and stir the meat until the fat is rendered and the edges are crispy. (10) The cooked meat is removed, and the green peppers are added to the rendered pork fat in the pink pan. A black spatula is used to press the peppers down, searing the skins until they develop a blistered, wrinkled texture. (11) After removing the peppers, the rendered pork fat is poured back into the pan. Eggplant chunks are placed skin-side down into the hot oil. The hands fry them until the purple skin appears glossy and the flesh is partially cooked. (12) All previously cooked ingredients—the browned pork belly and the blistered green peppers—are returned to the pan with the eggplants. The hands use a black spatula to toss the ingredients together, creating a colorful and well-distributed mixture. (13) A space is cleared in the center of the pan, and the prepared sauce along with sliced fresh red chilis is poured in. Everything is stir-fried quickly over high heat, creating a visible plume of steam as the sauce thickens and coats the food. (14) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a pink apron, stands in the brightly lit kitchen. She holds a rice bowl and uses chopsticks to eat a large bite of the dish, smiling with satisfaction. (15) The final shot shows the woman happily continuing to eat while text overlays with social media handles appear. The lighting remains bright, and the background shows a window with natural light filtering through wooden blinds.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, medium-tempo acoustic pop background music track featuring bright guitar strumming and light, rhythmic percussion. A female narrator introduces the dish with a friendly and enthusiastic voice, her pitch is high-energy but clear and professional. (2) As the recipe moves to the cutting board, the rhythmic, percussive sounds of a knife hitting wood become prominent. These sharp thuds are consistent and provide a natural tempo to the instruction, layered clearly over the ongoing background music. (3) A distinct metallic clink of a spoon hitting a bowl is followed by the soft, bubbly sound of water splashing. This acoustic texture confirms the transition to the soaking step, while the narrator’s voice remains steady and encouraging. (4) The sharp, rhythmic chopping sound returns as the green peppers are sliced. The transient impacts of the blade against the wooden board are crisp, indicating high-quality audio capture with minimal background noise interference or spectral blurring. (5) The sound shifts to a softer, more fluid slicing noise as meat is prepped. The frequency spectrum is lower than the vegetable chopping, reflecting the different physical texture of the pork belly being handled by the cook. (6) A high-pitched scraping sound of a wooden spoon against a ceramic bowl is clearly audible as the sauce ingredients are mixed. The BGM maintains its upbeat energy, and the narrator continues to deliver instructions without pause. (7) Light, crinkling and rustling sounds of paper towels indicate the eggplant is being dried. This incidental noise is brief and clear, followed by a soft dabbing sound as the moisture is physically removed on the board. (8) A metallic clink of tongs or chopsticks is heard, immediately followed by the initial soft sizzle of raw meat hitting the pan. The narrator's voice remains dominant in the center of the audio mix. (9) The sizzling sound intensifies, creating a broad frequency 'white noise' floor that represents the high-heat frying. Periodic scraping sounds of a spatula moving across the metal surface are interspersed within the sizzling texture as the meat browns. (10) A plate clinks as the meat is removed, followed by the louder, more percussive popping sizzle of green peppers hitting hot oil. The acoustic signature is bright and sharp, suggesting the peppers are releasing moisture into the hot fat. (11) A liquid splash sound is heard as the pork fat is reintroduced to the pan. This is immediately followed by a dense, bubbling sizzle as the eggplants are laid into the oil for their initial fry. (12) The sound of frying eggplants is heard, which has a slightly 'wetter' and lower-frequency sizzle compared to the meat. The narrator’s voice maintains a dynamic pitch contour, emphasizing key steps in the cooking process. (13) Multiple clattering sounds occur as plates are handled and various pre-cooked ingredients are returned to the hot pan. The overall audio energy is high, with the BGM, sizzle, and narration overlapping perfectly in the mix. (14) A sharp, high-pitched hissing sound occurs as the cold liquid sauce hits the hot surface of the pan, creating an immediate burst of steam-like noise. This transient event is followed by rapid, rhythmic stir-frying sounds. (15) The audio concludes with subtle mouth-smacking and chewing sounds as the dish is tasted, accompanied by a final rice bowl clink. The music swells slightly before fading out alongside the narrator’s upbeat final social media call-to-action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Ingredient Preparation -> Step-by-Step Cooking -> Visual Result -> Tasting -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a highly instructional and visually stimulating cooking tutorial aimed at teaching viewers a specific recipe for stir-fried eggplant with pork belly and peppers. By using high-speed editing, clear narration, and detailed close-up shots of the preparation and cooking process, the creator demonstrates the dish's ease of preparation and its high culinary appeal. The final segment, featuring the creator eating and enjoying the meal, serves as a sensory validation to encourage viewers to try the recipe and follow her social media channels.
